notes.content:
[b]Happy Valentine's Day![/b]
[i]Salangan Games[/i]

notes.title: Tickets to Sanctuary. Sale!
notes.content:
Friends, our visual novel Zeliria Sanctuary is still in demand and popular, even three years after its release! Of course, we couldn't leave the adventures of our beloved characters without a sequel. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256330/__2/]Part 2 of Zeliria Sanctuary: Xinori Asylum[/url] is slowly nearing its release, and now it's time to add it to your wishlist! 

And if you're not yet familiar with our game, now it’s perfect time to download and install it, because in honor of Lunar New Year we give you 55% discount!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Phoenix_co wishes all players a happy New Year!

We wish you good health and many new interesting games in 2022!
We also remind you that you can still buy some of the interesting games with discount until January 5. E.g., the Big pack from Phoenix bundle It will allow you to add 5 games to your New Year's collection at once.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13046/Big_pack_from_Phoenix/
But if you already have something from this collection, you can purchase only the missing games.

[b]Happy New Year![/b]

notes.title: DLC: "Zeliria Sanctuary - OST + ARTBOOK" UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear friends! We have already delighted you with a Halloween story in the Asle’s Memories DLC, and now it's time for a new holiday and... a new update!

This time we made a series of three comics about the world of Zeliria... and not only that (all Dune fans, fiery hello;))! The update has been added to the DLC "Zeliria Sanctuary - OST + ARTBOOK" and after the automatic update of the game, you can get acquainted with new terribly interesting stories!

Nightmarish pleasures for you!

notes.title: Reality's Reversу Side is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: Reality's reverse side is a quite unusual novel about an ordinary detective who has no cases for a long time. But one day everything changes and Stefan (that's the name of the main character) gets a new case, and a new life together with it, full of interesting, and sometimes very dangerous adventures. Do vampires exist? What is Zhonki hiding? Should you marry Cutie Hugh? Will Stefan be able to return to his former place of work? Or will he decide to stay? Or maybe he... will die? Well, you can find the answers to all these questions right now!

notes.title: The visual novel Happy New Year, Zeliria is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Friends, there hasn't been such a holiday as New Year on Zeliria... until this day! Today we will celebrate it for the first time!
In honor of the upcoming New Year, the Salangan Games team is presenting a visual novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490190/Happy_New_Year_Zeliria/]Happy New Year, Zeliria[/url]! Free New Year's story is already waiting for its readers. Congratulations from Leeka and Eyka attached!
And by the way, everything there again is not what it seemsːmaxx_amuletː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490190/Happy_New_Year_Zeliria/

notes.title: The visual novel Memory Note is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Friends! The visual novel Memory Note is now available on Steam! A fascinating story about two completely different people awaits you. The main hero has an absolute memory, but has a lot of problems with it. But one day he meets a girl who is not able to remember yesterday. What will come of this meeting? Will it become fateful or will it remain fleeting? Open our Memory Note to find out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321040/Memory_Note/

notes.title: New game "Pretty girls and dark witch. A simple story" is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Friends, we decided to distract a little from visual novels to please you with an erotic anime puzzle, among the characters of which there are your favorite Leeka and Eyka!
New game "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1463900/_/]Pretty girls and dark witch. A simple story[/url]" is now available on Steam! Have a nice game!

notes.title: Zeliria Sanctuary 2: Xinori Asylum demo is already available!
notes.content:
Friends, after a long break, we are here with great news again! Maxx's adventures in Zeliria continue! Today we are pleased to offer you the demo version of the second part of the game: Zeliria Sanctuary 2: Xinori Asylum. New adventures and new acquaintances in the sequel of your favorite story! The demo includes the beginning of the story and full Russian voice acting. 
All details and download link are on the project page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256330/__2/
Have a good game!

notes.title: Our new visual novel "Edge of Reality" is live on Steam now.
notes.content:
Edge of Reality visual novel is a mystical detective story with charming atmosphere of the early 20th century.
The game has an interesting plot and excellent musical accompaniment. But that's not all!  Edge of Reality will not only help you have a good evening or two, but will also allow you to learn a foreign language! In the unique bilingual mode, it is possible to select any language pair in the game (from 6 languages).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236860/

notes.title: The workshop is open!
notes.content: Since the game appeared in Steam, developers have heard questions from players about the possibility of making mods. Together with Salangan Games, we have been working on this for a long time and finally we announce the opening of the Zeliria Sanctuary Game Workshop. Do you want to create a new story about the adventures of your favorite heroes? To write an alternative ending? To give the characters a different character and abilities? You are welcome! Now all this has become possible! And so that you do not have to take a long time and need to understand the code and source codes, we have prepared a comprehensive instruction for you with a full description of all the variables, images and key functions that are used in the game.

notes.title: Happy birthday, Zeliria!
notes.content:
Dear friends! A year has passed since Zeliria Sanctuary released in STEAM.
Over the year we have received many reviews and suggestions.
On the occasion of the anniversary, we make a 45% discount for 2 DLC. The discount will start on January 8th. Celebrate with us!

P.S. Take a look at the attached image. This is one of the first backgrounds for the second part of our game. Demo is on the way, stay tuned!

notes.title: Winter Sale - Zeliria Sanctuary, 35% Off
notes.content:
Winter Sale Deal: Save 35% on Zeliria Sanctuary!
Great opportunity to add the game to your collection!

notes.title: Publisher Phoenix_co presents a new visual novel — «Earthshine».
notes.content:
December, 9 we will release the game Earthshine. This is a small beautiful story about love, about search of your purpose in life, and other things that people think about looking at the stars... This game is for those who love ancient legends or eastern tales. However, even if you are sometimes philosophic, take this story and start it at the right time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1174170/_/

notes.title: New DLC: Isle's Memories
notes.content:
DLC "Isle's Memories" - a terrible story full of scary pumpkins and, suddenly, very "spicy" moments. Nightmarish pleasures to you!

riends! We just couldn't miss our favourite Halloween fest and pumpkin theme in general! In this event, we present you another small DLC to Zeliria Sanctuary game - Isle's Memories. Creepy and quite "naughty" story about that night, shortly after which there was her meeting with Maxx and his friends.

notes.title: Added voice acting
notes.content:
All characters of the game are voiced by Studio AniLibria TV in Russian language. Each character has a unique voice. 
[list]
[*] [b]22 characters[/b]
[*] [b]13 actors[/b]
[*] [b]More than 10 hours of speech[/b]
[/list]
